boundaries.name: recursive-verification-soundness
boundaries.obligation: add_proof_target_and_verify under the constant switch verifier data is assumed (CircuitGates.fixedVerifierCall) to enforce a valid switch-board proof; plonky2 recursive verifier soundness, the exact public-input length and the algebraic meaning of the emitted gates are not proved.

boundaries.name: plonky2-builder-and-common-data
boundaries.obligation: try_build_with_options, common-data equality as an identity comparison, generate_cd's virtual verifier, the 4096-gate noop pad and vd_vec_len are opaque; no proof that the generated common data is the one the switch board and cyclic recursion actually require.

boundaries.name: cyclic-helper-semantics
boundaries.obligation: checkCyclic is a handwritten re-expression of plonky2's check_cyclic_proof_verifier_data (tail layout, cap_height word count, cap-then-digest comparison); its agreement with the upstream implementation and with the in-circuit carried-VD wiring is not refined.

boundaries.name: witness-and-native-verifier
boundaries.obligation: PartialWitness assignment, CircuitData::prove and CircuitData::verify are opaque callbacks; ordinary proof verification soundness and exact error strings are not modeled.

boundaries.name: serialization-codec-and-restored-circuit-trust
boundaries.obligation: bincode and gate/generator serializers are opaque; from_bytes discards the consumed byte count and never re-runs constructor consistency checks, so a restored circuit's data/target coherence is a caller trust assumption.

boundaries.name: balance-public-input-interface
boundaries.obligation: BalanceFullPublicInputsTarget::from_pis/to_vec and BALANCE_PUBLIC_INPUTS_LEN come from the imported BalancePublicInputs/SwitchBoard models (fullFromTarget, verifierLength); their refinement to balance_pis.rs is a separate line-map obligation.
